mutants.description: Mutant 1: Allows filings on the query date (<= instead of <), leaking same-day filings before execution.
Mutant 2: Uses linear term frequency instead of sublinear 1 + log(tf) scaling in tone calculation.
Mutant 3: Returns raw scores without demeaning and dividing by standard deviation.
Mutant 4: Inverts sentiment polarity by computing (neg - pos) / (pos + neg).
Mutant 5: Does not shuffle returns in permutation test, reporting identical observed correlation.
